title: HR System
tagline: Early Flutter HR client — employee records and internal workflows, kept public as a learning-to-product artifact.
overview: HR System is an early Flutter application for internal people-ops screens. The public repo is still the default Flutter starter in places — the value is the domain shape, not polished product marketing.
problem: I needed a non-commerce Flutter project to practice forms, lists, and role-specific screens around employees rather than products.
solution: A Flutter HR shell covering employee-oriented navigation and records. Honest about its starter roots.
architecture: Standard Flutter app structure (screens, widgets, default project layout) aimed at HR entities instead of a store.
challenges: Not overselling a learning repo as a finished HRIS
lessonsLearned: Domain models (employee vs product) change the UI more than the framework does
futureImprovements: Replace leftover starter copy with a real design system if this is ever reused
results: Public Flutter HR experiment that sits beside later production apps
